python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, sys
from datetime import datetime
import yaml, jsonschema

text = open("journals/2026-11-02-order-500s-null-price.md").read()
assert text.startswith("---\n")
front = text.split("\n---\n", 1)[0][4:]
core = yaml.safe_load(front)

schema = json.load(open("skills/investigate/journal.schema.json"))

def normalize(obj):
    if isinstance(obj, dict):
        return {k: normalize(v) for k, v in obj.items()}
    if isinstance(obj, list):
        return [normalize(v) for v in obj]
    if isinstance(obj, datetime):
        return obj.isoformat()
    return obj

jsonschema.validate(normalize(core), schema)

ids = {e["id"] for e in core["evidence"]}
refs = [r for h in core["hypotheses"] for r in h["evidence_for"] + h["evidence_against"]]
missing = [r for r in refs if r not in ids]
assert not missing, missing
rc = core["root_cause"]["hypothesis"]
assert any(h["id"] == rc and h["state"] == "validated" for h in core["hypotheses"])
s, c = core["investigation"]["started"], core["investigation"]["concluded"]
if isinstance(s, str): s = datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
if isinstance(c, str): c = datetime.fromisoformat(c.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
delta = int((c - s).total_seconds())
assert delta == core["usage"]["wall_clock_seconds"], delta
assert core["investigation"]["id"] == "2026-11-02-order-500s-null-price"
print("schema valid; references resolve; root cause is a validated hypothesis; wall clock matches")
EOF
